known.title: Gate: Exclude unrelated agent-ready guidance from this part

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - landing this selected diff also changes client-wide retry, identity and reporting rules outside this part's Scope.
The selected base-to-head change includes GUIDE-only edits in src/forge/standards.md:164, both hosts' skills/forge/standards.md:164, docs/guide.md:187, src/forge/templates/conventions/api.md:69, backend.md:74, python.md:77, and tests/test_agent_ready_guide.py:1. These implement FORGE-AGENTREADY-1/GUIDE; neither shipping the agents page nor naming it requires these eight files. The separate approved GUIDE plan explains their purpose but does not make them necessary for this scoped part. Use a base that excludes the GUIDE changes, or separate them from this patch.
